name: Rosario Palmieri
current_role: Assistant Secretary of Labor for Policy (since December 2025)
summary: Rosario Palmieri runs the Labor Department’s Office of the Assistant Secretary for Policy, its in-house regulatory and policy shop. He was confirmed 53–43 on December 18, 2025, in a block vote of 97 nominees.
